confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Lyon prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain, especially July peak-season hotel rates. Euro-denominated prices were converted using an assumed EUR/USD rate of roughly 1.15 to 1.18. The FX observation comes from RBA homepage content as at 4pm on 15 October 2026, read from search results; I did not open the RBA table directly. Cocktail and wine were estimated from direct local knowledge rather than from the beer anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other large French regional cities with strong tourism demand, such as Bordeaux and Strasbourg. Lyon's bouchon restaurant culture is the main reference for meal prices.
